title: Direct-image comparison and inverse ordinary pasting for fixed upper comparison
statement: Let X,Y,S,T be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y quasi-compact and quasi-separated, g:S→Y and h:T→S. Suppose ordinary base change is invertible on QCoh complexes for f against g, for the resulting second projection against h, and for f against h followed by g [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let k:(X×Y S)×S T→X×Y T satisfy both projection equations [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write U,L,V for the quasi-coherent pullbacks along the outer first projection, k, and the two inner first projections; write P,Q for quasi-coherent direct images along the outer and inner second projections [def-pc-derived-pullback,def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Write B for pullback along h followed by g and H for successive pullbacks along g and h. Let α be the outer inverse base-change square and δ the horizontal paste of the two inner inverse squares [lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate]. For any fixed s:U⋙L≅V with L an equivalence and s having exactly the ambient three-factor component prescribed by the first projection equation and the pinned pullback composition family [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], there exist p:L⋙Q≅P and b:B≅H such that, for every QCoh complex E on X, Q(s_E) followed by δ_E equals p_{U(E)} followed by α_E followed by b_{Rf(E)}. This statement constructs no s and proves no equivalence of L.

proof.text: Construct p and b with their canonical ambient component formulas, without ordinary base-change invertibility.
Apply ordinary compatibility to the constructed p,b and fixed s.

Reflect the three ambient component isomorphisms through the fully faithful QCoh inclusions. Promote the ordinary transformations to isomorphisms. Identify the inverse QCoh base-change components with their inverses. Cancel the pasted ordinary map, the comparison p, and the outer ordinary map in the compatibility identity to obtain exactly Q(s)delta=p alpha b.

theorem rectangle_ordinary_geometric_direct
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (h ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβS : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβI : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g),
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (k : pullback (pullback.snd f g) h ⟶ pullback f (h ≫ g))
    (hk₁ : k ≫ pullback.fst f (h ≫ g) =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ pullback.snd f (h ≫ g) = pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) :
    let U := qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))
    let L := qcPullback k
    let V := qcPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
      qcPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let P := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _
      (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    let Q := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) _ _
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let B := qcPullback (h ≫ g)
    let H := qcPullback g ⋙ qcPullback h
    let α := qcInverseBaseChange f (h ≫ g) hβ
    let δ := qcInverseBaseChange f g hβS ≫ₕ
      @qcInverseBaseChange _ (pullback f g) S T _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h hβI
    ∀ (s : U ⋙ L ≅ V) (hL : L.IsEquivalence) (hs : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map (s.hom.app E) =
        (let comp := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
         (comp k (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).hom.app E.obj ≫
           eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ (derivedPullback v).obj E.obj) hk₁) ≫
           (comp (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
             (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app E.obj)),
    ∃ (p : L ⋙ Q ≅ P) (b : B ≅ H),
      (∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        Q.map (s.hom.app E) ≫ δ.app E =
          p.hom.app (U.obj E) ≫ α.app E ≫ b.hom.app ((qcDirectImage f).obj E))
